notes: Heritage-site board in open steppe at the Abiwert ruins (Kaka District, Ahal); sign is small in the frame. Lower text: 'historical-cultural monument registered by the state', register no. AH87-001. The Y of YADYGÄRLIGI shows no visible acute (standard spelling would be ÝADYGÄRLIGI); transcribed as seen. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.

author: Allan Mustard
attribution: Photo: Allan Mustard, CC BY-SA 4.0, via Wikimedia Commons. Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Nyyazow-Turkmenistan-city-limit-sign.png. License: https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/. Unmodified original.
notes: White town-limit board on a pole beside a rural road, Dashoguz region (place now renamed Şabat). The second word shows no visible diaeresis on the A (standard spelling ŞÄHER, 'city'); transcribed as seen at this size. location is where the photo was taken (Commons camera coordinates), not the target.

notes: Overhead gantry of three white direction panels on an Ashgabat avenue; MARY and BAJGYRAN are on blue route patches, airplane pictogram after AEROPORT. A smaller repeater sign (TELEWIZION MINARASY / BAJGYRAN) and a small BEKREWE sign below are duplicates.
